questions.question: A boy added all natural numbers from 1 to 12, however he added one number twice due to which the sum becomes 80. What is the number which he added twice?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of first 12 **natural numbers** = [12 × (12 + 1)] ÷ 2

Actual Sum = 6 × 13 = 78

Given total sum after adding a **number twice** = 80

**Repeated number** = New Sum − Actual Sum = 80 − 78 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range of numbers = 1 to 12

Sum obtained = 80

**Formula used:**

Sum of first **n natural numbers** = n(n + 1) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22409391616028bfb95e4d42492769c4c0616dfde85f13aa8b8983d649968340.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Actual sum of numbers from 1 to 12 = [12 × (12 + 1)] ÷ 2

⇒ Sum = [12 × 13] ÷ 2 = 6 × 13 = 78

⇒ Let the **repeated number** be x.

⇒ Sum including the repeated number = 78 + x

⇒ 78 + x = 80

⇒ x = 80 − 78

⇒ x = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to calculate the sum of squares is [n(n + 1)(2n + 1)] ÷ 6.

Sum of Cubes of first n Natural Numbers

The formula to calculate the sum of cubes is [n(n + 1) ÷ 2]².

Sum of first n Even/Odd Numbers

Sum of first n **even numbers** is n(n + 1), and sum of first n **odd numbers** is n².</p

questions.question: Raman is 25% more efficient than Aman. If Aman can complete a piece of work in 25 days, then Raman can complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Let Aman is 100% efficient

Then Raman will be 125% efficient

Now, 100% efficient can do work in 25 days

1% efficient will do work in 25 ⨯ 100%

∴ 125% efficient can do work in 25 ⨯ 100%/125% = 20 days

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 30 day. They started together but after 6 days A left the work and the work is completed by B after 36 more days. A alone can complete the entire work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Let efficiency of A be a and B be b

Work = efficiency ⨯ time

30 ⨯ (a + b) = 6(a + b) + 36 b

24(a + b) = 36b

24a = 12b

2a = b

Let a = 1 and b = 2

∴ Work = 30 ⨯ 3 = 90 units

Time taken by A alone = 90/1 = 90 days

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 40% more than its cost price. If 10% discount is given, then what is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Let CP be Rs. 100

MP = 40% more than CP = 140

Discount = 10% of MP = 10/100 ⨯ 140 = 14

SP = MP - Discount = 140 - 14 = Rs. 126

Profit = 126 - 100 = Rs. 26

∴ Profit % = 26/100 ⨯ 100 = 26%

questions.question: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 27. What is the product of the first and the last number?
questions.solution:
Let 1st odd digit be x

Then next four odd digits = (x + 2), (x + 4), (x + 6), (x + 8)

According to question,

⇒ [x + (x + 2) + (x + 4) + (x + 6) + (x + 8)]/5 = 27

⇒ x + (x + 2) + (x + 4) + (x + 6) + (x + 8) = 135

⇒ 5x + 20 = 135

⇒ 5x = 115

∴ x = 23

Hence required product = 23 ⨯ 23 + 8 = 23 ⨯ 31 = 713

questions.question: On an article the profit is 210% of the cost price. If the cost price increase by 40% but the selling price remains constant, then approximately what percentage of selling price will be the profit?
questions.solution:
Let CP be Rs. 100

Profit = 210% of 100 = 210

SP = Rs. 310

By increasing CP by 40%

New CP = Rs. 140

SP remains constant

New Profit = Rs. (310 - 140) = Rs. 170

Now, % age of SP to profit = profit/SP ⨯ 100 = 170/310 ⨯ 100 = 54.83 ≃ 55

questions.question: If the price of apple increases from Rs. 80/kg to Rs. 100/kg, then by what percentage a person should decrease the consumption of apple so that his expenditure remains same?

questions.question: A boat travels 60 kilometers downstream and 20 kilometers upstream in 4 hours. The same boat travels 40 kilometers downstream and 40 kilometers upstream in 6 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the stream?
questions.solution:
Let speed of boat in still water be x and speed of current be y.

According to the question,

60/(x + y) + 20/(x - y) = 4 ----(1)

40/(x + y) + 40/(x - y) = 6 ----(2)

∴ On solving (1) and (2),

x + y = 40

x- y = 8

Speed of stream, y = 16

questions.question: 50 trees are standing in a line such that distance between any two consecutive trees is same. A car takes 18 seconds to travel from 13th tree to 34th tree. How much time (in seconds) will it take to reach from 1st tree to 50th tree?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the distance between two consecutive trees be x m

Distance from 13th to 34th tree = 21x m

Time = 18sec

Speed = 21x/18 = 7x/6

Now distance between 1st to 50th tree = 49x m

**∴ Time = 49x/(7x/6) sec = 42 sec**

questions.question: What will be the amount on Rs. 12500 at the rate of 20% per annum compounded yearly for 3 years?
A certain sum becomes 7 times in 8 years, at simple interest, then in how many years will it become 19 times?
questions.solution:
Let the amount be P

Then S.I. for 8 years = 6P

If amount is 19 times then S.I. = 18 P

Using unitary method

6P in = 8 years

P in = 8/6

18P in = 18 × (8/6) = 24 years

questions.question: By how much percent expenditure of company Q and R together greater than that of company P?
